lines.say: You sat down to start at two. You looked up, and it was six.
Not because you didn't care. A day with too many starts is hard to hold on your own.
Offload holds the plan. Open it, and it tells you what to do today. Just the next block.
And if today goes sideways, it moves the work, and tells you what moved.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
